gcp._note: cidr_blocks is empty per the TransitHub model's own docstring -- an NCC Hub, like an AWS Transit Gateway, has no CIDR of its own. asn is null: NCC hubs carry no ASN (that lives on a Cloud Router, which has no canonical resource type in this contract -- see NOTES.md). route_table_urns is empty because NCC route tables (NccRouteTable) are not one of this contract's 21 canonical resource types either; the raw route table names are preserved in extensions.gcp.route_table_names instead.
